data.name: Gyanu
data.gender_notes: Gyanu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Gyanu is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'gyan' meaning 'knowledge'. The name signifies one who is wise, learned, and knowledgeable. It is a name of great reverence and respect, often given to children who are expected to carry on the family's intellectual legacy. The name Gyanu carries the meaning “Knowledge, Wise” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gyanu usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The pursuit of knowledge and wisdom is a lifelong journey.
data.etymology: Gyanu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledge, Wise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gyanu total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
